what_happened: The job to tell verifiers to reuse Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test results (a prompts-class change) failed. The producer stage did not finish and hit its 1800-second deadline. No work product was delivered. The event lists no unmet criteria, findings or failed checks. The time limit ended the job, not a verdict on the work.
cause: The producer runs against one fixed wall-clock deadline. Nothing reports progress, saves partial work, or separates a stalled producer from a slow one. Nothing checks that a prompt edit stays small. This request may have been wider than it looked, since it touches how verifiers find and trust recorded results. The earlier same-class case shows the gap was known and not closed, so a second small prompts job burned the full 1800 seconds with nothing to diagnose or resume from.
prevention: Give the producer stage a progress signal and an early-stop rule. It would write a checkpoint (files touched, criteria addressed) at intervals. If no checkpoint or diff appears within a fraction of the deadline, the stage aborts early and records why. On deadline, the job keeps the partial diff and checkpoint and reports a timeout, not a plain failure. A retry then resumes from that state. For prompts-class jobs, the planning stage must also name the one file and the edit, so a producer that finds the task wider than planned stops and says so.
proposed_request: Make producer runs resumable and observable. (1) While a producer runs, record a checkpoint at regular intervals with the files changed so far and the acceptance criteria addressed. (2) If a producer shows no file change or checkpoint after one third of its deadline, stop it early and record the reason. (3) When a producer reaches its deadline, keep the partial diff and checkpoints, mark the job as timed out (distinct from a failed verdict), and let `athena retry` resume from that state. Then retry job 20261019-013309-nvbb: tell verifiers to reuse Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test results instead of rerunning them, in the verifier prompt only, with no code changes. Done when the timeout path is shown by a test with a stalled fake producer that leaves partial state and a timed-out status, and the verifier prompt contains the reuse instruction.
